name: [Collector] Weekly cross-source report
job:
Collect data from these sources and generate a consolidated weekly report:
1. Git activity: run 'git log --oneline --since=7.days.ago' and summarize commits.
2. Job history: check logs/ for completed jobs this week.
3. Cron health: verify all enabled crons ran successfully.

Before generating the report: validate each source returned data. If any source returns zero records, flag it as an anomaly. Include a data quality section at the top. Save report to logs/.
